note: Primitive DNR state forest campground on a loop in the woods south of Lost Lake (panfish), with a boat ramp, a dock and nature trails. Sites are a cleared area with fire ring and table. --Claude
summary: DNR re-read: 15 sites (1 accessible), vault toilets, well water, boat ramp, $17 tax-included, same-day online payment (old 'paid at the campground' was wrong). Manager Scenic State Park 218-571-2600. Stored lakeview is not supported on imagery: spurs end 40-50 m from the shore behind continuous forest; recommend not waterfront. Website to hyphen form. Pin within ~100 m of the DNR point.
flags: WATERFRONT DOWNGRADE lakeview -> not waterfront (stored value is not --AWH): on the 180 m Esri frame the nearest spurs on the north side of the loop (about 47.68587,-93.40660 and 47.68545,-93.40563) end about 40-50 m from the south shore of Lost Lake through a continuous band of dense forest; the only opening to the water is the dock path (dock about 47.6861,-93.4057). The stored evidence itself says the site clearing 'sits ~35-40m back behind a continuous shoreline treeline'. DNR gives no site map or campsite photos showing a lake view, so nothing supports a view value; default down.
PHONE: none stored; manager 'Scenic State Park' 218-571-2600 (DNR facility record cmp00023).
Pin 47.6858,-93.4050 sits at the lake edge ~100 m NE of the DNR facility point 47.685101,-93.40587 (which is inside the loop). Under 250 m; optional move to the DNR point.

NOTE correction: the fees note said 'paid at the campground'; DNR says fees are paid online on the arrival day and 'DNR does not accept self-payment envelopes on site'. Note cleaned of the site count, toilets, water and hookups (fields hold them).
ACCESS alert (no effect on the campground): DNR sft00021 alert 'South Lofgren Road - Closed due to flooding'.
Season: no DNR statement of open dates for this campground; nothing written.
